name: Kiyosato Yui
source:
The daughter of [url=http://vndb.org/c1669]Misako[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c1671]Takao[/url]. She's had a weak heart since a young age, so she's never attended school. Instead, she's a long-term patient in the Kiyosato Hospital.

[summarized from [url=http://slpr.sakura.ne.jp/RensaByo-toh/yui.php]official site[/url]]
